# Let me try clicking on a checkerboard cell (not on a yellow object)
# The checkerboard is from rows 9-40, cols 19-44

print("Clicking on checkerboard cell at row 10, col 20")
result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': 10, 'col': 20}])

# Check what changed

after = last_transition.after_frame
before_lines = before.ascii.split('\n')
after_lines = after.ascii.split('\n')

print("\nChanged rows:")
for r in range(len(before_lines)):
    if r < len(after_lines) and before_lines[r] != after_lines[r]:
        print(f"  Row {r}: {before_lines[r][:50]} -> {after_lines[r][:50]}")

# Check segmentation for changes
before_seg = before.segmentation
after_seg = after.segmentation

print(f"\nBefore nodes: {len(before_seg['nodes'])}, After nodes: {len(after_seg['nodes'])}")

print("\nLevel completed?", result.get('level_completed', False))
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
